title: Bind emitting source to its tracking-plan item with a resolving Telemetry: header

facts.note: Test files are excluded; path/file-kind classification separates tests from implementation.
Adoption alternative 1: a telemetry root exists. Either this OR the acceptance-declaration fact establishes adoption.

values: acceptance file with a telemetry declaration
facts.note: Adoption alternative 2, independent of the telemetry root: an acceptance telemetry declaration anywhere in the repository. Needs an observer scanning acceptance files for telemetry declarations.
Validator findings over every existing `// Telemetry:` line comment (outside string literals) in non-test source, whether or not the header or the plan changed in this diff.

values: non-test source emits telemetry without a header naming the emitted item
facts.note: Declaration part (S013): no mechanical emission observer exists, so whether source emits telemetry and lacks a header for it is judged by reviewer/LLM.

fires: A non-test source file in an adopting repository carries a `// Telemetry:` line comment whose value is not a concrete URN of the form telemetry:{kind}:{plane}:{theme}:{artifact}[:{measure}].
An existing, unchanged `// Telemetry:` header names a grammatical URN that has no tracking-plan item.
A tracking-plan item is renamed or removed while source headers still reference the old URN.
Non-test source in an adopting repository emits a telemetry item but has no `// Telemetry:` header naming it.
The repository has no telemetry root but has an acceptance telemetry declaration, and a source header is non-concrete, unresolved or missing for emitted telemetry.
doesNotFire: The repository has no telemetry root and no acceptance telemetry declaration anywhere (capability not adopted), whatever profiles run.
The `// Telemetry:` text appears in, or telemetry is named by, a test file (telemetry tests legitimately name items while asserting them).
The `Telemetry:` text appears inside a string literal.
The reference is written as a block comment or markup attribute (not parsed in this realization).
Non-test source that emits no telemetry and carries no `// Telemetry:` header.

given: In a telemetry-adopting repository, non-test source emits telemetry or carries a `// Telemetry:` line comment.
when: The source is written, edited or checked, or the tracking plan renames/removes an item.
then: Each emitted item is declared by name in a `// Telemetry:` header, and every header names a concrete URN `telemetry:{kind}:{plane}:{theme}:{artifact}[:{measure}]` matching a JSON tracking-plan item id under telemetry/<theme>/<artifact>/.
prefer: `//` header above the emitting code, e.g. `// Telemetry: telemetry:event:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted`.
Update headers in the same change when the plan renames.
avoid: URNs naming no plan item, incl. stale after rename.
Block comments, markup attributes, string literals as headers.
Naming an item the file does not emit just to resolve.
unless: Not adopted (no telemetry root, no acceptance telemetry declaration anywhere): nothing emitted, whichever profiles run.
Test files: they legitimately name items while asserting them.
why: The header is the source-to-telemetry traceability edge; like Tested-By, a checkable promise: the URN is well-formed and the registry holds it.
evidence: The bun_telemetry_code validator reports no grammar finding (non-concrete URN) for any source header.
The bun_telemetry_code validator reports no resolution finding: every header URN matches a JSON registry entry id under telemetry/<theme>/<artifact>/.
Reviewer confirms that every non-test file that emits telemetry carries a `// Telemetry:` header naming each item it emits (and only items it emits).
verifier_detail: Parse only `//` line comments of the form `// Telemetry: <urn>` in non-test source files; ignore occurrences inside string literals (a header inside a string literal is not a header); block comments and markup attributes are not parsed in this realization.
Report two distinct failures: grammar (value is not a concrete URN telemetry:{kind}:{plane}:{theme}:{artifact}[:{measure}]) and resolution (grammatical but no tracking-plan item with that id).
tracking_plan_item: a JSON registry entry under telemetry/<theme>/<artifact>/ whose id is the referenced URN.
Inert until adopted: if there is no telemetry root and no acceptance telemetry declaration anywhere, emit nothing regardless of profiles run.
Exclude test files from the scan (tests are implementation's mirror, not implementation).
telemetry_reference binds the file to the concrete item it emits; scan all existing headers, not only changed ones.
Declaration check (implementation source that emits telemetry names it in a header) has no mechanical detector in bun_telemetry_code; it is established by review/LLM judgment of emission.
audit: Source name: 'Source Telemetry references resolve into the tracking plan'.
Fix-hint example function: `export function acceptResponse(response, telemetry) { ... }` placed under the header.

S013 ('Implementation source that emits telemetry says so, by name, in a header comment.') is kept operative in this rule's then/avoid[0]; a separate companion may also exist (graph.json edge) but this rewrite does not rely on it.

splitSuggestion.then: Implementation (non-test) source that emits telemetry declares each emitted item by name in a `// Telemetry:` line-comment header; same adoption gate and test exclusion; judged by review since no emission observer exists.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: The declaration obligation (S013) is kept operative here, combined with resolution into a single binding obligation in `then`; splitSuggestion proposes optionally moving it into a separate convention with LLM-judged activation, since its observability differs from the mechanical grammar/resolution checks.
additions.justification: Auditor required S013 to be operative in this rewrite unless a traced companion demonstrably covers it.
Source binds the file to the item(s) it emits and gives no single-item limit; resolves ambiguity for multi-item files.

additions.text: avoid[1] examples (missing parts, wildcards, placeholders) and avoid[4] (naming a non-emitted item to make it resolve).
additions.justification: Concretises 'not concrete' and blocks gaming of the resolution check, consistent with S008 'the concrete item it emits'.

additions.text: Activation facts and fires/doesNotFire situations, incl. plan-rename trigger, unchanged unresolved headers, two independent adoption signals, and the LLM-judged emitting-without-header case.
additions.justification: Required by the target structure; derived from the source's terms, normative text, fix hint and exceptions.

additions.text: verifier_detail[6]: scan all existing headers, not only changed ones; verifier_detail[7] and evidence[2]: declaration is review-judged.
additions.justification: The obligation applies to every reference regardless of edit history; the validator only covers grammar/resolution, so declaration needs a stated verification path.
